message: Thank you for moving on price. I can't confirm your current offer: it pays 60% at shipment and has no late-price cut, which we can't work with. I also can't share our budget or limits, only what I'm proposing. Here is a revised counter with a higher price, a 14-day ship-by, and a late-price cut. Any agreement still needs to be read and signed by a person at our company.
